events.title: A silver spoon went missing
events.prose: Maren noticed a heavy silver spoon vanish from the table during the breakfast rush. She watched the patron's trembling hands, but she didn't say a word to the cook.

events.title: The soot-stained debt
events.prose: Pipkin accidentally knocked over a crate of dried spices while weaving through the crowd. He left before the merchant could demand payment, leaving a trail of yellow dust behind him.

events.title: A heavy secret shared
events.prose: Kaelen poured three fingers of dark ale for a man who looked like he'd seen a ghost. He listened to the confession in silence, nodding slowly as the lantern light flickered.

events.title: The quick hand's mistake
events.prose: Elias attempted a light-fingered lift near the boarding gates. He secured the coin purse, but the weight of it felt wrong, and he hasn't quite decided if he should return it.

memories.text: Elias lifted a heavy coin purse from a sleeping merchant's belt near the North Gate Station.
He owed Barliman three silver marks for a tab left open at the Rusty Spoke Inn.
He swiped a brass key from the counter while Barliman turned to serve a fresh round of ales.
Maren watched Barliman scrub the grease from the counters while the morning fog rolled in.
She saw a man's grip tighten on his spoon when he lied about the silver piece.
Maren kept the secret of the missing utensil tucked behind her eyes like a hidden coin.
Kaelen watched Barliman scrub the heavy oak counter with a weary, rhythmic motion.
He polished the brass tap until his own tired eyes reflected back at him.
He kept the coin Barliman gave him for settling the tab of the man who never returned.
Pipkin left a trail of yellow spice dust behind him after he collided with a merchant's crate.
Pipkin swiped a bruised apple from Barliman's counter when the man turned to face a customer.
Pipkin owed three copper bits to Elias Thorne for a pair of thin-soled boots.
